scope: Metadata only: request-log fields, SDK local-store event types and counts, and constants read from the Claude Code 2.1.285 binary. No prompts, outputs, tool results or credentials.

sdk_usage_timing.source: SDK local store of the Claude instance, latest 400 runs, event types only
sdk_usage_timing.finding: The SDK emits one usage message per run, at turn end after all of its tool calls, summed over every model call of the run. A run paused for client tool results has none, so a tool-use response cannot carry real usage.

calibration.source: 176 completed cold Messages requests with SDK usage
calibration.estimate: prompt_bytes / 2.3 + 3000 preamble + 1600 per image, shared with count_tokens and prompt_too_large

claude_code_2_1_285.auto_compact_window: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, clamped to the model window

change.reported_usage: Each response reports the estimate for its own prompt and output. The request log keeps SDK usage in usage and adds reported_usage.
change.context_after_tool_results: User messages ride in the last tool result under a per-run marker and the paused run continues; system, developer and assistant messages still rebuild.
change.slots: A run awaiting tool results releases its slot and retakes one on resume, even above the limit; new requests wait until inference drops below it.
change.orphan_queued_jobs: Cancelled after 30 s without a waiting request and logged as orphan_cancelled; started inference always finishes.
